title: Wasted Mom Flips Truck After Driving Into Oncoming Traffic!
description:
On April 10th, 2023, at around 12:05 pm, officers in New Mexico responded to an intersection where a truck had crashed into another vehicle. On arrival, officers witnessed the truck flipped on its side while the other blue vehicle had significant damage. 

The driver of the truck was released to officers to begin their investigation after being cleared medically by EMS. The other driver was not seriously injured and was taken by EMS to a nearby hospital for evaluation. The three children, who were not injured in the incident, were also taken by EMS to a nearby hospital for evaluation as a precaution.
